jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of experience in software development with expertise in Python, Java, or JavaScript. You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable microservices architecture, leading technical projects, and mentoring junior developers. Strong experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines is required. You should have excellent problem-solving skills and experience with Agile methodologies. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field required. Experience with machine learning and data science is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Join our data science team to build predictive models and drive data-driven decision making. We need someone with 3-5 years of experience in machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization. Proficiency in Python, R, SQL, and experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch is essential. You will work with large datasets, develop ML models, and create insightful dashboards. Experience with NLP, computer vision, and deep learning is highly valued. Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, or related field preferred. Strong communication skills to present findings to stakeholders.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Looking for a Full Stack Developer with expertise in modern web technologies. Must have 2-4 years of experience with React, Node.js, and MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You will develop responsive web applications, RESTful APIs, and collaborate with UX/UI designers. Knowledge of TypeScript, GraphQL, and cloud services (AWS/Azure) is required. Experience with Redux, Next.js, and microservices architecture is a plus. Strong understanding of web security, performance optimization, and testing frameworks. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to optimize our cloud infrastructure and deployment processes. Requires 5+ years of experience with AWS or Azure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), and container orchestration (Kubernetes). Strong scripting skills in Python or Bash, experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI), and monitoring solutions (Prometheus, Grafana). You will automate deployments, ensure system reliability, and implement security best practices. Knowledge of service mesh, GitOps, and SRE principles is highly desired.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: We need a strategic Product Manager to lead our B2B SaaS product line. Requires 6+ years of product management experience, with proven track record of launching successful products. You will define product vision, create roadmaps, conduct market research, and work closely with engineering and sales teams. Strong analytical skills, experience with A/B testing, user research, and data-driven decision making. MBA preferred. Experience with Agile/Scrum, JIRA, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel) required.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Join our ML team to build and deploy production-ready machine learning models. Need 3-5 years of experience with Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and MLOps. You will develop ML pipelines, optimize model performance, and implement A/B testing frameworks. Experience with computer vision, NLP, and recommendation systems is valued. Strong software engineering skills, experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms required. Knowledge of MLflow, Kubeflow, and model monitoring is a plus. MS in Computer Science or related field preferred.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Looking for a creative Frontend Developer passionate about building beautiful user interfaces. Requires 1-3 years of experience with React or Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+. You will implement responsive designs, optimize performance, and ensure cross-browser compatibility. Knowledge of TypeScript, Webpack, and CSS preprocessors (SASS/LESS) required. Experience with Redux, Material-UI, and accessibility standards (WCAG) is a plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to work with designers using Figma/Sketch.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Seeking a Backend Engineer to build scalable server-side applications. Need 3-5 years of experience with Python/Django or Node.js, RESTful APIs, and database design (PostgreSQL, MongoDB). You will develop microservices, optimize database queries, and implement caching strategies (Redis). Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka), GraphQL, and event-driven architecture required. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services is essential. Strong understanding of security best practices and API authentication.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description: Join our security team to protect critical infrastructure from cyber threats. Requires 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, incident response, and vulnerability assessment. Proficiency with SIEM tools (Splunk/QRadar), penetration testing, and security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001). You will conduct security audits, implement security policies, and respond to security incidents. Knowledge of cloud security (AWS/Azure), network security, and scripting (Python/PowerShell) required. Certifications like CISSP, CEH, or Security+ preferred.

jobs.title: Mobile Developer
jobs.description: Looking for a Mobile Developer to create innovative iOS and Android applications. Need 2-4 years of experience with React Native or Flutter, and native development (Swift/Kotlin). You will build cross-platform mobile apps, integrate APIs, and implement push notifications. Experience with state management (Redux/MobX), mobile CI/CD, and app store deployment required. Knowledge of mobile security, performance optimization, and offline data synchronization is valued. Understanding of Material Design and iOS Human Interface Guidelines.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description: Seeking an experienced Cloud Architect to design enterprise-scale cloud solutions. Requires 7+ years of experience with AWS/Azure/GCP, with deep expertise in cloud architecture patterns, security, and cost optimization. You will design multi-region architectures, implement disaster recovery strategies, and lead cloud migrations. Strong knowledge of containerization, serverless computing, and Infrastructure as Code required. Experience with hybrid cloud, multi-cloud strategies, and cloud governance frameworks. AWS/Azure certifications strongly preferred.

jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description: Join our QA team to ensure software quality through comprehensive testing strategies. Need 3-5 years of experience in test automation using Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright. You will create test plans, develop automated test suites, and perform API testing. Experience with CI/CD integration, performance testing (JMeter), and mobile testing required. Knowledge of BDD/TDD, test management tools (TestRail/Zephyr), and programming skills in Python or JavaScript essential. ISTQB certification is a plus.

jobs.title: Blockchain Developer
jobs.description: Looking for a Blockchain Developer to build decentralized applications and smart contracts. Requires 3-5 years of experience with Solidity, Web3.js, and Ethereum blockchain. You will develop smart contracts, implement DeFi protocols, and ensure security best practices. Experience with other blockchains (Polygon, Binance Smart Chain), IPFS, and consensus mechanisms required. Knowledge of cryptography, tokenomics, and DApp development frameworks (Truffle/Hardhat) essential. Understanding of gas optimization and audit processes.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.description: Seeking a creative UI/UX Designer to craft exceptional user experiences. Need 3-5 years of experience with Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD, and strong portfolio demonstrating user-centered design. You will conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and collaborate with developers. Experience with design systems, responsive design, and accessibility standards (WCAG) required. Knowledge of HTML/CSS, user testing methodologies, and animation tools (Principle/After Effects) valued. Strong visual design skills and understanding of typography and color theory.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain large-scale data pipelines. Requires 5+ years of experience with Apache Spark, Hadoop, and cloud data platforms (Snowflake/Databricks). You will design ETL/ELT processes, implement data warehouses, and ensure data quality. Strong SQL skills, experience with Python/Scala, and knowledge of streaming technologies (Kafka/Kinesis) required. Experience with data orchestration tools (Airflow/Dagster), data governance, and real-time analytics valued. Understanding of data modeling and dimensional design.
